task_instance: Implement a minimal Terraform Plugin Framework provider ('exampleprovider') with an ephemeral resource 'exampleprovider_token' that issues a simulated short-lived token for a role_name, following the skill's Open/Renew/Close lifecycle, Private-passed lease_id, RenewAt margin, and EphemeralResources() registration; then verify it with an echoprovider-based acceptance test gated to Terraform >= 1.10, per the skill's Testing section.
tools_used: terraform CLI 1.10.5 (downloaded locally since system terraform was 1.9.8, below the 1.10 minimum for ephemeral resources)
evidence: Built exampleprovider module in this directory: internal/provider/provider.go (ProviderWithEphemeralResources, EphemeralResources() returning NewTokenEphemeralResource), internal/provider/token_ephemeral_resource.go (Open/Renew/Close implementing EphemeralResourceWithRenew/WithClose, Sensitive token attribute, lease_id passed via resp.Private.SetKey/req.Private.GetKey, RenewAt set with a 2-minute safety margin), main.go (providerserver.Serve). `go build ./...` succeeded. Downloaded terraform 1.10.5 to ./.bin (system terraform was 1.9.8, below the ephemeral-resources minimum) via `curl https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/1.10.5/terraform_1.10.5_linux_amd64.zip`. Wrote internal/provider/token_ephemeral_resource_test.go: an acceptance test using tfversion.SkipBelow(tfversion.Version1_10_0) and the echoprovider pattern the skill's Testing section prescribes (ephemeral value flows into `echo.test` resource's `data`, checked with statecheck.ExpectKnownValue against role_name and a token regex). Ran `PATH=$(pwd)/.bin:$PATH TF_ACC=1 go test ./internal/provider/... -run TestAccTokenEphemeralResource_basic -v`, output: '--- PASS: TestAccTokenEphemeralResource_basic (1.87s)' / 'ok exampleprovider/internal/provider 1.884s'. This confirms Open is invoked, the ephemeral token/lease_id values are correctly typed and surfaced (never persisted directly, only observable via the echo test resource as the skill's own testing guidance describes), and the provider registers/serves the ephemeral resource correctly.
